title: Angels & Demons
author: Dan Brown
summary: A Harvard symbologist is summoned to a Swiss laboratory after a scientist's murder, then to Rome, where an old secret society seems to be threatening the Vatican during a conclave. A ticking clock drives every chapter.
readIf: you like a hurried, clue-by-clue chase through famous landmarks with a ticking clock.
skipIf: you want subtle characters or religion and science handled with nuance.

pairings.reason: Langdon's other big case, with a very similar chase-and-puzzle structure and a wider canvas.
Another Langdon thriller that swaps Rome for Washington and Freemasonry.
A more serious, procedural thriller that also runs on a clock and meticulous planning.
